description: Search full post text within one accessible stream, newest first. Supports ISO date bounds; custom-target restrictions apply. Continue with nextOffset; this differs from opaque history tokens. Use get_stream_posts to page by date without a text query; the search tool finds streams, not posts.

fromDate.description: Earliest post creation time to include, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts in this page.

offset.description: Matches to skip: 0 for the first page, then nextOffset from the previous page.

streamId.description: ID of a stream whose posts you can read, such as one you own or follow.

text.description: Words to find in post text; every word must match. Supports "exact phrase", -word to exclude, a | b for either, and prefix*.

toDate.description: Latest post creation time to include, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset; not before fromDate.

name: search_stream_posts
title: Search stream posts
